doc.title: Wendy Oxenhorn — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Subletting from Holly Woodlawn on 10th Street
summary: Panken asks about the Warhol superstar's house; Oxenhorn regrets just missing that scene.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: I think I read, researching you on the Internet, you lived in a house that had belonged to Holly Woodlawn, the Warhol “superstar.”

Yes, we were subletting from her on 10th Street. I think that’s when she went to go have her... Oh, no, it must have been well after. But she was the one, wasn’t she, who had the sex change operation? The first?
But what I missed... Had I just been born a few years earlier, I would have been dangerous. I would have met all these amazing...
Well, it sounds like you’ve met a lot of amazing people anyway.
